description: React TSX (jest + RTL): CartSummary test mocks the project's own useCart hook and only asserts that it was called.
pr_body: Add a CartSummary component that shows the item count and total from the cart.

acceptable.reason: jest.mock of the project's own useCart module couples the test to the implementation.
The rendered item count and total text is never asserted.

expected.notes: weak_test on the toHaveBeenCalled assertion; the own-module mock and unasserted output are acceptable side findings. The weak assertion may be anchored on the test or on the unasserted render line.
